scenario.title: Conflicting deletion samples and approval status

documents.text: QA reports deletion for 3 of 3 sampled accounts. This is an engineering sample result, not privacy approval.
Operations reports deletion for 2 of 3 sampled accounts, with one remaining record. Its account list may differ from QA; the samples have not been reconciled.
A named reviewer must compare the account lists and record a go/no-go decision. This document contains no approval. A no-go decision can also answer the review question.
